name: Plekt
description: Configure the complete Plekt webhook address in Jellyfin. The plugin forwards playback and explicit watched/unwatched events to Plekt's existing webhook endpoint.
overview: Send Jellyfin playback and watch-state changes to Plekt.

versions.changelog: Show the Plekt wordmark on a transparent background so it blends with Jellyfin's plugin page.

Send explicit watched and unwatched changes to Plekt. Jellyfin raises user data saves outside its event manager, so the previous consumer never ran. Send Jellyfin ids without dashes, as Jellyfin's API does, so Plekt recognises its own writes. Log each delivered watched-state change.
